UPMK.description: Long-service pay on termination: from two months' wage after three years of service up to ten months' after 24 years (at least the worksite minimum wage a month), for the causes that carry it (PP 35/2021 art.40(3)). A micro or small enterprise pays the agreed amount.

references.title: PP 35/2021 arts.15–17: a fixed-term worker who is not a foreign national (art.15(5): “tidak berlaku bagi tenaga kerja asing”, read on `employee.nationality`, not on tax residency) with at least one month of continuous service receives one month of basic wage plus fixed allowances per 12 months served, pro rata, including an early end. Article 16(6) replaces that schedule with the worker-employer agreement for a micro or small enterprise. PP 35/2021 art.15(2) pays the compensation when the PKWT ends, and PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid "dengan nama dan dalam bentuk apapun, sehubungan dengan berakhirnya masa kerja atau terjadi pemutusan hubungan kerja", so it carries the final PPh 21 severance rates (`PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE`) and leaves the TER base; a non-resident's is PPh 26. Kring Pajak (DJP, 7 June 2023) refers compensation paid in connection with the end of service to PP 68/2009 and PMK-16/PMK.03/2010. Art.15(4): when a PKWT is extended the compensation for the period before the extension is paid when that period ends (PKWT_TERM_END_COMPENSATION duty), and the extension’s when it ends: the band prices the months of the term in force (`terms.effective_from` to the exit or the term’s end), one month’s wage per 12 (art.16(1)): “masa kerja/12 × 1 (satu) bulan Upah”, the service counted in completed calendar months and the part month at ÷30 a calendar day (as PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION), so a term ending part-way through a month is paid for those days.

PKWT_COMPENSATION.description: Compensation when a fixed-term contract ends: one month's wage (basic plus fixed allowances) for every 12 months served, pro rata. Not for a foreign worker (PP 35/2021 arts.15–17).

references.title: PP 35/2021 arts.49–52 and 54: the listed causes carry separation pay only where and at the amount stated in the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement. PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4 defines uang pesangon as income paid under whatever name and in whatever form in connection with the end of service or termination, so uang pisah carries the final PPh 21 severance rates (`PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE`) and is outside the TER base; a non-resident's is PPh 26.

UANG_PISAH.description: Separation pay on the last day of employment, at the amount the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement states, for a resignation and the other causes that carry it (PP 35/2021 arts.49–52).

references.title: PP 35/2021 art.58: the portion of a pension benefit funded by the employer may count toward pesangon, UPMK and separation-pay obligations only where the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement provides it; the employer pays any shortfall.

PENSION_OFFSET.description: On the last day of employment, sets the employer-funded part of a pension benefit against severance and service pay, deducting the amount entered. Only where the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement provides it (PP 35/2021 art.58).

references.title: PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(b): on termination the cost or fare home for the worker and family to the place where the worker was accepted for work is paid (customer input: the cost entered; `entry.hired_at_other_place` — the worker was taken on elsewhere). PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4: uang penggantian hak is part of the final severance base.

UPH_TRAVEL_HOME.description: On termination, the fare home for the worker and family to the place where the worker was taken on, at the cost entered (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(b)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 art.61(1)–(2): an employer paying the wage late owes a fine counted from the day it was due: from the 4th to the 8th day 5% of the wage due for each day late; after the 8th day 1% more for each further day, the month’s fine at most 50%; after a month the highest state-bank interest rate on top (entered separately by the employer). The wage itself stays due (art.61(2)); the fine is income received in connection with the work (PPh 21 additional). Days are counted from the due day as day 1 (“terhitung tanggal seharusnya Upah dibayarkan”, art.61(1)(a)): a wage paid three days after its due day is paid on the 4th day and carries 5%. The record takes this reading, the worker’s, of the counting the regulation leaves open.

LATE_WAGE_FINE.description: The fine owed to a worker for a late wage, on the monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances): 5% for each day from the 4th to the 8th day counted from the due day, then 1% for each further day, at most 50% in the month (PP 36/2021 art.61). The entry quantity is the day number on which the wage was paid.

references.title: PP 36/2021 art.62(1)–(2); Permenaker 6/2016 art.10(1)–(2): an employer paying THR late owes a fine of 5% of the THR due (`entry.thr_due_amount`), managed and used for the workers’ welfare — an employer cost, not the worker’s pay; the THR stays due.

LATE_THR_FINE.description: The fine for paying the religious holiday allowance late: 5% of the allowance due, which is the amount entered. An employer cost used for the workers' welfare; the allowance itself stays due (PP 36/2021 art.62).

references.title: PP 35/2021 art.53(1)–(2): a worker detained by the authorities on suspicion of a crime is not paid the wage, but the employer gives the dependants aid — 25% of the wage for one dependant, 35% for two, 45% for three, 50% for four or more (the `family` members without income) — for at most 6 months from the first day of detention: one entry a month, a seventh is refused.

DETENTION_FAMILY_AID.description: Aid to the family of a worker detained by the authorities, who is not paid the wage: 25% of the monthly wage for one dependant, 35% for two, 45% for three and 50% for four or more (PP 35/2021 art.53).

references.title: PP 68/2009 art.5: the pension benefit, old-age savings or JHT paid at once carries the final PPh 21 of art.5 (PPH21_FINAL_PENSION), outside the TER base.

PENSION_LUMPSUM.description: A pension benefit, old-age savings or JHT paid at once, at the amount entered. It carries its own final PPh 21 and stays out of the monthly tax (PP 68/2009 art.5).

references.title: UU 36/2008 art.4(1)(a) as amended by UU 7/2021; PMK 66/2023 (official text, jdih.kemenkeu.go.id) arts.3–8 and Lampiran A: a benefit in kind is taxable income of the employee at its value (`entry.amount`), except (`entry.natura_kind`): food and drink at the workplace for all employees (art.5(1)(a)); meal coupons for field staff up to Rp2,000,000 a month, or the workplace meal value if higher (art.5(4)); facilities required for safety at work — uniforms, safety equipment, shuttle transport, crew lodging (art.6); facilities in a DJP-designated remote area (art.8); religious-holiday parcels for all employees (Lampiran A.1); other gifts up to Rp3,000,000 a year (A.2); work equipment such as laptops and phone credit (A.3); medical care for work accidents (A.4); sports facilities up to Rp1,500,000 a year (A.5); communal housing (A.6); individual housing up to Rp2,000,000 a month (A.7); a company car for an employee without equity and with average gross up to Rp100,000,000 a month (A.8, `entry.car_user_qualifies`); employer pension contributions to an OJK-approved fund (A.9); worship facilities (A.10). The excess over a ceiling is taxable (art.7(4)). Not paid in cash: the line is DISPLAY and reaches only the PPh 21 base.

NON_EMPLOYEE_FEE.description: A fee for services paid to an individual who is not an employee, at the amount entered, one entry for each payment. PPh 21 is charged on 50% of each payment (PMK 168/2023 art.12).

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.62 (kept by UU 6/2023; https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003): a party that ends a fixed-term agreement (PKWT) before its term, other than on the art.61(1) grounds (death, the term or the work ending, a court decision, an event the agreement names), pays the other party damages of the worker’s wage up to the end of the term. It is owed beside the PP 35/2021 art.15–17 compensation (PKWT_COMPENSATION). Paid by the employer when it ends the employment (exit ground DISMISSAL, REDUNDANCY, RETRENCHMENT or UNILATERAL); as income paid in connection with the end of the work it carries the PP 68/2009 final severance rates (PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE), a non-resident’s PPh 26.

PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION.description: Damages the employer pays for ending a fixed-term contract before its term: the monthly wage for the time left to the end of the term (UU 13/2003 art.62).

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.62 (kept by UU 6/2023; https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003): a party that ends a fixed-term agreement (PKWT) before its term, other than on the art.61(1) grounds (death, the term or the work ending, a court decision, an event the agreement names), pays the other party damages of the worker’s wage up to the end of the term. Priced here as the monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances, `terms.monthly_wage`) for each whole month from the day after the exit to the term’s last day (`entry.term_end_date`, else the term’s own end `terms.effective_to`), and the part month at ÷30 a calendar day (the record’s reading). It is owed beside the PP 35/2021 art.15–17 compensation (PKWT_COMPENSATION). Owed by the worker who resigns before the term ends; recovered from the final pay as damages, within the PP 36/2021 art.65 50% deduction ceiling (WAGE_DEDUCTION_CEILING), the rest being a debt outside payroll.

references.title: PP 35/2021 arts.31–32: the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage (art.32(2)), on basic plus fixed allowances (art.32(3)). Each day of the attendance window is priced on its overtime (an order and the worker's consent, art.28), derived from the recorded clock: on an ordinary working day the hours past the planned shift, the first at 1.5× and every further hour at 2× (art.31(1)); on a weekly rest day or an official holiday every hour worked is overtime — every paid hour of the day less hours banked as time off, each hour counted once — for a 6-day / 40-hour week hours 1–7 at 2×, hour 8 at 3×, hours 9–11 at 4× (art.31(2)(a)), and when the holiday falls on the shortest working day (scheduled 5 hours or less) hours 1–5 at 2×, hour 6 at 3×, hours 7–9 at 4× (art.31(2)(b)); for a 5-day / 40-hour week hours 1–8 at 2×, hour 9 at 3×, hours 10–12 at 4× (art.31(3)). Hours beyond the last listed hour stay at 4×. A daily-paid worker's month is the agreed daily wage × 25 on a 6-day week or × 21 on a 5-day week (art.33(1)). Where basic plus fixed allowances are below 75% of the whole wage, the base is 75% of the whole wage (art.32(4)).

PP 35/2021 art.27(2)–(5): no overtime wage for a golongan jabatan tertentu — only where the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines that group. Art.33(2)–(3): output pay (PIECE_RATE) takes the average of the last 12 months gross less overtime, floored at the worksite minimum wage.

references.title: PP 46/2015
references.quote: JHT is 5.7% of the monthly wage, 2% from the employee and 3.7% from the employer (art.16). Contribution wage is upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap — the standing car, housing and special allowances are in the base; a reimbursement is not. Wages paid by the day make a month of the day's wage × 25, whatever days were paid (art.17(3)). Piece-rate worker: art.19(4)–(5) take the average wage of the last 3 months, 12 where the work depends on the weather. The row averages this tax year's paid months from the balance; only months of this employment count and the first month uses the current paid wage. The employer registers every worker for JHT (art.2(1)); the contribution runs from the day the worker starts (art.9(2)); a negligent employer pays the contribution it owed (art.11(4)). A worker outside an employment relationship is a non-wage-earning participant who registers and pays for himself (art.4(2)–(3)).

The row averages this tax year's paid months from the balance; only months of this employment count and the first month uses the current paid wage. A recipient paid outside an employment relationship (PMK 168/2023 bukan pegawai: NON_EMPLOYEE, IRREGULAR_COMMISSIONER, ACTIVITY_PARTICIPANT; a former employee; a pension withdrawal) is a non-wage-earning participant who registers and pays for himself (art.5(2)–(3), art.11(1)), so charged nothing as a worker of this employer.

references.title: PP 45/2015
references.quote: JP is 3% of the monthly wage, 1% from the employee and 2% from the employer, charged on wage up to an annually adjusted ceiling (art.28–29). JP covers Indonesian nationals only; a foreign national cannot be registered for JP (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan). Existing PP45/2015 art.15(4) and Permenaker29/2015 art.3 allow a confirmed still-employed participant to defer benefits and continue contributions for at most three years beyond pension age; this election is supported in every 2025–2026 seed version. A THR (Permenaker 6/2016 art.2–3) and a bonus are neither upah pokok nor tunjangan tetap, so they are outside the JP wage; the row reads upah sebulan as PP 44/2015 art.19 states it: the contract's wage plus fixed allowances, a day's wage × 25, piece work its average.

references.locator: art.30 as amended, art.1 angka 2, art.2, art.5(3)–(4), art.13(1), art.13(5), art.14(1), art.32, art.36
references.quote: Kesehatan is 5% of the monthly wage, 1% from the employee and 4% from the employer, charged on wage between a floor and a ceiling (art.30; art.31 was deleted by Perpres 64/2020 and art.30(2) is the direct-payment rule). A further family member (a fourth child, a parent, a parent-in-law) is enrolled at the worker's election and costs 1% of the (capped) wage each, paid by the worker (art.5(3)–(4), art.30(1)(b), art.36); the regulation states no ceiling on their number. A participant is every person, a foreigner included, who works at least six months in Indonesia (art.1 angka 2; the same six-month reading JHT, JKK and JKM apply, PP 44/2015 art.1 angka 4); a foreigner on a contract shorter than six months is outside Kesehatan (art.2). Art.13(1) obliges the employer to register itself and its workers "dengan membayar Iuran", art.13(5) leaves the health benefit on an employer that has not registered and paid, and art.14(1) requires each spouse's employer to register and pay. Contributions are monthly (art.30, art.32(1) "per bulan"), so a deferred earlier month paid as back pay is floored and capped at 12,000,000 on its own beside this month's wage. references.locator: arts.5(3), 8, 12, 13, 15(1)–(2), 21(1); the tables are PP 58/2023 Lampiran A–C
references.quote: For each tax period other than the last, PPh 21 of a permanent employee is the month's gross income (penghasilan bruto: all regular and irregular pay of the month, art.5(1), including the employer-paid JKK, JKM and BPJS Kesehatan premiums; the employer's JHT and JP shares are not income) times the TER rate of the employee's category. Tables as reproduced in the PMK annex, upper bounds inclusive ("s.d."): A (44 brackets, 0% to Rp5,400,000 up to 34% above Rp1,400,000,000), B (40, 0% to Rp6,200,000 up to 34% above Rp1,405,000,000), C (41, 0% to Rp6,600,000 up to 34% above Rp1,419,000,000). The last tax period — December, or the month a permanent employee stops working (art.15(1)(b)) — takes the year's tax at the UU PPh art.17(1)(a) rates on penghasilan kena pajak rounded down to the full thousand: the year's gross less biaya jabatan (5%, at most Rp6,000,000 a year, art.10), less the employee's own JHT and JP contributions, less PTKP; the tax withheld is that tax less the TER already withheld in the year; an excess must be returned to the employee at the latest by the end of the next month (art.21(1)): PPH21_REFUND returns it. Residents only: CITIZEN and RESIDENT_FOREIGNER; a NON_RESIDENT is taxed under PPh 26.

references.title: PMK 168/2023
references.quote: Art.10(2) and the Lampiran worked examples cap biaya jabatan at Rp500,000 for each month worked in the tax year ("maksimal 4 X Rp500.000,00" for a September joiner). Art.10(1)(b): the employee's own contribution to an OJK-approved pension fund reduces the year's gross like JHT and JP. Art.10(1)(c): zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer is deducted. Art.15(3): where the subjective tax obligation starts after January or ends before December (tax_subject_from, tax_subject_until), the net income is annualised (× 12 / months) and the tax prorated (× months / 12); the month the subject status ends is the last tax period. Art.12(2)(b), 16(2)(b) and Lampiran III.1.5(b): a daily worker above Rp2,500,000 a day is taxed at the art.17(1)(a) rates on 50% of each day's gross. Art.1: a pegawai tetap includes one on a fixed-term contract (PKWT) receiving regular income, who has the December/exit reckoning; a monthly-paid PART_TIME or DAILY worker uses monthly TER without a December reckoning. Art.1(11): a worker paid by the day, hour, unit or task, or part-time, is non-permanent and records pph21_payment_cadence. MONTHLY uses monthly TER on the month's wages (art.12(2)(c)). NON_MONTHLY divides the wages by the days worked: 0% through Rp450,000 and 0.5% through Rp2,500,000 on the whole (PP 58/2023 Lampiran D; art.16(2)(a)), or art.17 on 50% of the average day, by the days, above it (art.16(2)(b), Lampiran IV.1.3–4). A married female employee takes TK/0 unless she holds a written local-government statement at least at kecamatan level that her husband has no income. PTKP facts are read as at 1 January, or the first of the arrival month for a new resident (art.9(4)–(5)): a ptkp_standings entry of exactly that date wins, two refuse, and without one the run reads the contract in force, because a run sees no earlier contract. A married female employee explicitly declares the husband-income position. Owner rule 2026-10-22: PPh 21 is owed on the month's gross, so a payment made before the month's salary run is withheld at what it adds to the month; the TER rate is a flat rate on the month's whole gross and the December/exit reckoning is progressive, so an off-cycle THR or bonus paid first is withheld at the month's bracket, not at the bracket of the bonus alone.

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.59 as amended by UU 6/2023

PROBATION_RULES.description: Refuses probation longer than three months and probation on a fixed-term contract.

PKWT_WRITTEN_INDONESIAN.description: Requires every fixed-term contract to record that its signed agreement is in Indonesian and Latin script.
PKWT_WRITTEN_INDONESIAN.condition:
if (!['EMPLOYEE', 'CONTRACTOR', 'PART_TIME', 'INTERN', 'APPRENTICE'].includes(get(ctx.entry, 'engagement', ''))) return false;
return get(ctx.entry, 'signed_contract_period.to', null) != null;

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.57(1) as amended by UU 6/2023

FOREIGN_WORKER_PERSONNEL_POSITION.description: Refuses a foreign worker declared to hold a personnel position.

MINIMUM_AGE.description: Refuses a contract for a worker under 13 on the contract start date.

CONTRACT_CATEGORIES.description: Requires the engagement, statutory work category and residency status to be declared values.

SHARED_STRUCTURED_EMPLOYEE_INPUTS.description: Requires a worksite region for wage earners, a passport for foreign residents, and a birth city for non-residents.

SHARED_STRUCTURED_ENTITY_INPUTS.description: Requires the company registration number and a 15- or 16-digit tax registration number in the company's parameters.

ESTABLISHMENT_EVENT_DATE_REQUIRED.description: Requires an establishment date when the entity declares its first worker or the start of operations.

ROSTER_UNDER_13.description: Refuses a roster day for a worker under 13; the same rule supplies the seeded daily and weekly work limits.

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.68: employers may not employ children; art.69 allows light work from 13 to 15 only. The contract site refuses the same (MINIMUM_AGE).

entity_extension_schema.title: ID entity extension data
entity_extension_schema.description: Stored as entity_extension_data. The region is a key of the minimum-wage rule by_region map (the BPJS Kesehatan floor and the art.157 output floor), and risk_class is the JKK group I–V (PP 44/2015 art.16(1)); both are read from this data.

enterprise_size_class.title: Enterprise size for BPJS
enterprise_size_class.description: Perpres 82/2018 art.32(4)–(5) as amended by Perpres 59/2024: micro and small enterprises are outside the ordinary UMP/UMK contribution floor. Perpres 109/2013 art.6(3), PP 37/2021 art.4(3) as amended: they are outside JP.

wlkp_first_reported_on.title: First WLKP report
wlkp_first_reported_on.description: The day the company first reported under UU 7/1981 art.6; the annual report falls on its anniversary (art.8).

company_regulation_valid_until.title: Company regulations valid until
company_regulation_valid_until.description: The last day of the ratified Peraturan Perusahaan (at most 2 years, UU 13/2003 art.111(3)).

umsp_export_oriented.title: Exporter (sector minimum wage)
umsp_export_oriented.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_assets_over_1_trillion.title: Assets above Rp1 trillion (sector minimum wage)
umsp_assets_over_1_trillion.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_astra_group.title: Astra group member (sector minimum wage)
umsp_astra_group.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_class_a_private_hospital.title: Class A private hospital (sector minimum wage)
umsp_class_a_private_hospital.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_hotel_star.title: Hotel star class (sector minimum wage)
umsp_hotel_star.description: DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran row 60: star hotels of 4 and 5 stars; Banten Kep. 704/2025 Lampiran V (Kota Tangerang sector 3): 3, 4 and 5 stars. Sumatera Utara Kep. 188.44/909/KPTS/2025 annex XI (Medan): exact 3-, 4- or 5-star class selects a separate rate.

klu.title: Main KLU (DJP)
klu.description: The main business classification code in the DJP database (on 1 January of the year, or the registration day): selects the PPh 21 DTP incentive (PMK 105/2025 art.3; PMK 10/2025 art.3).

managerial_group_defined.title: Golongan jabatan tertentu defined
managerial_group_defined.description: The employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines the art.27(2) managerial group exempt from overtime pay (PP 35/2021 art.27(4)–(5)).

lks_bipartit_formed_on.title: LKS Bipartit formed on
lks_bipartit_formed_on.description: The day the bipartite cooperation body was formed (UU 13/2003 art.106).

k3_high_hazard.title: High hazard potential
k3_high_hazard.description: The workplace has a high hazard potential: SMK3 applies whatever the headcount (PP 50/2012 art.5(2)).

dkptka_usd_idr_rate.title: DKPTKA USD rate
dkptka_usd_idr_rate.description: Rupiah per US dollar the DKPTKA (USD 100 a foreign worker a month) is paid at.

construction_services.title: Construction services (jasa konstruksi)
construction_services.description: The employer is in the construction-services sector (PP 44/2015 art.1(10), BAB VI): its daily, piece, task and PKWT workers pay JKK at 1.74% of the monthly wage (art.54(1)).

umsp_rayon_viscose.title: Rayon viscose staple fibre (sector minimum wage)
umsp_rayon_viscose.description: Kep. Gubernur Jawa Barat 561.7/Kep.876-Kesra/2025, Purwakarta: KBLI 20302 rayon viscose (5,193,876) rather than polyester (5,062,344); record it only where the worksite makes rayon viscose.

umsp_freeport_area.title: Works in the PT Freeport Indonesia area (Mimika sector minimum wage)
umsp_freeport_area.description: Kep. Gubernur Papua Tengah 100.3.3.1/337/2025 diktum KETIGA (2026: any company) and 258/2024 diktum KESATU 3 (2025: a construction company): a company working in the PT Freeport Indonesia area pays the Mimika mining sector minimum wage. Unrecorded is false.

umsp_bank_category.title: Bank category (sector minimum wage)
umsp_bank_category.description: Medan annex XI of Kep. 188.44/909/KPTS/2025: private conventional foreign-exchange bank (printed KBLI 2015 64125, KBLI 2020 64121), foreign-exchange syariah bank (2015 64131, 2020 64122), or another bank. Declare actual licensed status; the broader KBLI 2020 code does not establish it.

region.title: Minimum-wage region
region.description: The employer region, a key of the minimum-wage rule by_region map (Provinsi X, or Provinsi X/Kota|Kabupaten Y): the BPJS Kesehatan floor and the art.157 output floor read it, and it is the fallback where a contract names no worksite region.

risk_class.title: JKK risk class
risk_class.description: The BPJS Ketenagakerjaan work-accident risk group I–V (PP 44/2015 art.16(1)); it sets the JKK employer rate.

registration_number.title: Company registration number (NIB)
registration_number.description: The business identification number (NIB) issued through OSS.

tax_registration_number.title: Tax registration number (NPWP)
tax_registration_number.description: The employer NPWP: 15 digits in the legacy format, or 16 digits where it uses the NIK-based number.

established_on.title: Date of establishment
established_on.description: The actual date the employer was established.

operations_started_on.title: Date operations started
operations_started_on.description: The actual date this establishment began operating, distinct from incorporation and the date of the company's change.

first_employed_on.title: Date the business first employed a worker
first_employed_on.description: The actual date the business first employed a worker, including employment before this workspace.

jkk_labour_intensive_industry.title: Labour-intensive industry under the 2025 JKK relief
jkk_labour_intensive_industry.description: Set only where the company qualifies under PP 7/2025 as extended by PP 36/2025: the JKK rate is halved for the contribution months February 2025 to January 2026.

employee_extension_schema.title: ID employee extension data

zakat_monthly.title: Zakat paid through the employer a month
zakat_monthly.description: Zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer to a recognised body; deducted from gross income (PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(c)).

pph26_treaty_rate.title: PPh 26 treaty rate
pph26_treaty_rate.description: The tax-treaty rate for a non-resident who has given the certificate of domicile (PMK 168/2023 art.14(1)–(2)).

tax_id_validated.title: NPWP or DJP-validated NIK
tax_id_validated.description: True when the employee has an NPWP or a NIK validated by DJP; false applies the 20% higher rate (UU 36/2008 art.21(5a)) and bars the DTP incentive (PMK 105/2025 art.4).

pph21_dtp_reference_gross.title: DTP reference gross
pph21_dtp_reference_gross.description: The fixed and regular gross of January of the incentive year, or of the first month worked in it (PMK 105/2025 art.4(2)(b); PMK 10/2025 art.4(2)(b)).

pph21_dtp_reference_year.title: DTP reference year
pph21_dtp_reference_year.description: The year the DTP reference gross was measured in.

severance_tax_history.title: Severance original benefit payment year
severance_tax_history.description: Raw original first-payment year of one benefit lineage. Must match the earliest native paid capture. Gross/tax totals are derived from original captures. Missing/external openings and multiple lineages refuse; no calculated annual history declaration is accepted.

first_payment_year.description: Calendar year the first part of this same benefit was paid, including payments before imported payroll history.

pension_tax_history.title: Pension original benefit payment year
pension_tax_history.description: Raw original first-payment year of one benefit lineage. Must match the earliest native paid capture. Gross/tax totals are derived from original captures. Missing/external openings and multiple lineages refuse; no calculated annual history declaration is accepted.

first_payment_year.description: Calendar year the first part of this same benefit was paid, including payments before imported payroll history.

jp_continue_after_pension_age.title: Continue JP after pension age
jp_continue_after_pension_age.description: JP only: for an Indonesian citizen still employed at age59–61 who has notified BPJS of the choice to defer pension benefits and continue contributions. Record true only for the confirmed election. Contributions must stop no later than three years after pension age (age62 in2026). Permenaker29/2015 art3(3)–(4); PP45/2015 art15(4).

kesehatan_extra_members.title: Extra BPJS Kesehatan family members
kesehatan_extra_members.description: KESEHATAN: family members beyond the spouse and three children the worker enrols (Perpres 82/2018 arts.30(1)(b), 36): 1% of the capped wage each, deducted from the worker.

ptkp_standings.title: Reviewed historical PTKP standings
ptkp_standings.description: PTKP stands as at 1 January of the payment year, or the first of the arrival month for a new resident (PMK 168/2023 art.9(4)–(5)). Record actual historical facts at exactly that date where they differ from the contract in force: a run sees no earlier contract. A single reviewed entry must match the exact date; duplicates refuse payroll.

ptkp_dependents_count.title: Fully supported qualifying dependants on that date

husband_no_income_certified.title: Reviewed husband no-income statement
husband_no_income_certified.description: Required for a married female employee; true requires the actual local-government statement reference.

worksite_kbli.title: Worksite KBLI
worksite_kbli.description: The five-digit KBLI of the worksite's activity; selects the governor's sector minimum wage.

umsp_job_category.title: Job category (sector minimum wage)
umsp_job_category.description: DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 rows 58–59 (bus drivers and mechanics of private companies) and 61 (nursing and midwifery, medical support at a class A private hospital).

tax_subject_from.title: Resident tax subject from
tax_subject_from.description: The day this person became an Indonesian resident tax subject, where that is in the current year (PMK 168/2023 art.15(3)).

tax_subject_until.title: Resident tax subject until
tax_subject_until.description: The last day as an Indonesian resident tax subject, where it ends in the current year (leaving Indonesia for good); that month is the last tax period.

written_in_indonesian.title: PKWT written in Indonesian
written_in_indonesian.description: The PKWT is in writing in Indonesian and Latin script (UU 13/2003 art.57(1) as amended).

indonesia_work_months_planned.title: Planned months of work in Indonesia
indonesia_work_months_planned.description: For a foreign worker: the planned period of work in Indonesia; under 6 months the worker is insured privately, not by BPJS (UU 24/2011 art.14; PP 34/2021 art.8).

dplk_employee_monthly.title: Employee pension-fund contribution a month
dplk_employee_monthly.description: The employee’s own monthly contribution to an OJK-approved pension fund (DPLK/DPPK), deducted from the year’s gross for PPh 21 (PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(b)).

personnel_position.title: Personnel (HR) position
personnel_position.description: The position handles personnel; a foreign worker may not hold it (PP 34/2021 art.11).

dkptka_exempt.title: Exempt from DKPTKA
dkptka_exempt.description: The foreign worker’s position is exempt from the DKPTKA compensation (PP 34/2021).

pre_employment_exam_on.title: Accepted pre-employment examination date
pre_employment_exam_on.description: PER.02/MEN/1980 art.2(7): an examination within the previous three calendar months can remove the need for another pre-employment examination.

pre_employment_exam_accepted.title: Previous examination meets statutory requirements
pre_employment_exam_accepted.description: A physician satisfying art.1(d) performed the recorded examination and there is no doubt about its suitability (art.2(7)). A date alone does not qualify.

pph21_payment_cadence.title: Non-permanent worker tax payment cadence
pph21_payment_cadence.description: A non-permanent worker's tax cadence. MONTHLY uses monthly TER without an annual reckoning (PMK 168/2023 art.12(2)(c), annex III.2). NON_MONTHLY uses the daily TER on the average day, or art.17 on 50% above Rp2,500,000 a day (arts.12(2)(a)–(b), 16(2)).

termination_cause.title: Statutory termination cause
termination_cause.description: The statutory ground (PP 35/2021 arts.41–57; from 28 October 2026 UU 27/2026 arts.236–249); it chooses the pesangon and UPMK multipliers and whether UPMK or uang pisah is owed. MERGER_CONSOLIDATION_SEPARATION: the worker will not continue after a merger, consolidation or separation; MERGER_EMPLOYER_UNWILLING: the employer will not take the worker on. Required for a PKWTT exit.

micro_small_enterprise.title: Micro or small enterprise
micro_small_enterprise.description: PP 35/2021 art.59: a micro or small enterprise pays the severance agreed with the worker instead of the statutory formula.

pension_offset_applies.title: Employer-funded pension offset applies
pension_offset_applies.description: PP 35/2021 art.58: an employer pension programme's benefit is set against the separation pay.

exit_ground.title: Departure ground
exit_ground.description: The ground the employment actually ended on. It selects the final-benefit treatment; the statutory pesangon cause remains termination_cause (PP 35/2021 arts.41–57).

hired_at_other_place.title: Hired away from home
hired_at_other_place.description: The worker was taken on somewhere other than the place of work, so the cost or fare home for the worker and family is part of uang penggantian hak (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(b)).

statutory.title: Statutory registrations
statutory.description: The employee's registration or membership number with each statutory fund or account.

registration_number.title: JHT registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: JP registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: KESEHATAN registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: PPH21 registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

employee_extension_schema.description: Additional Indonesian compliance facts on the employment, stored as employee_extension_data. Current shared personal data remains structured. PPh21 uses a real contract covering 1 January or the new-resident arrival-month start; where no contract covers that date, a reviewed PTKP historical standing records the actual dated external facts. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

references.title: Employment agreement or company regulation
references.quote: A work-related medical test is reimbursed at its evidenced cost; it is not wages.

SWAB_TEST_REIMBURSEMENT.description: Reimburses the cost of a swab test to the employee with net pay, at the amount entered. An employer benefit under the employment agreement or company regulation.

references.title: Employment agreement or company regulation
references.quote: A medical claim is paid at its evidenced cost within the entitlement the employer sets; paid through payroll it is part of gross pay.

MEDICAL_CLAIM.description: Medical claim against the annual limit.

references.title: PP 36/2021
references.quote: Pemotongan Upah untuk utang atau cicilan utang Pekerja/Buruh dilakukan berdasarkan perjanjian, paling banyak 50% dari setiap pembayaran Upah.

references.title: SKB 3 Menteri No. 1497 Tahun 2025, No. 2 Tahun 2025 and No. 5 Tahun 2025 — 8 cuti bersama days for 2026. For the private sector the SKB is guidance the employer implements, and a cuti bersama day taken is set against the annual leave entitlement.

JOINT_LEAVE.description: A collective leave day (cuti bersama) the employer applies. It is paid, and each day taken comes off the annual leave balance.

references.title: Law 13/2003 Art. 79(3) as amended by Law 6/2023 Window: each year of service (`SERVICE_YEAR`): UU 13/2003 art.79(3) grants 12 days after each 12 months of continuous work. Continuous work is the current unbroken stint; where the employee profile counts cumulative service, every stint counts, which gives no less. Owner ruling (ID): the balance resets each leave year and at most 5 unused days carry into the next (`carry_forward`), once. On exit the unused, unlapsed balance is paid (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a)).

UU 13/2003 art.79(3) as amended by UU 6/2023 art.81 angka 25 — at least 12 working days after 12 months of continuous work; art.79(4) leaves how it is taken to the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement

ANNUAL_LEAVE.description: Paid annual leave accrued by service.

references.title: PP 36/2021 art.40(1): no wage for a day not worked — except the absences art.40(2)–(5) pays (illness, menstruation, family events, state duty, religious duty, union duty, company training, work withheld by the employer, rest and leave) and a suspension during dismissal (UU 13/2003 art.157A); an unpaid absence recorded with one of those reasons is refused. Breastfeeding time is working time (UU 13/2003 art.83; UU 4/2024 art.4(1)(c)) and is never booked as unpaid.

NPL.description: Unpaid absence: no wage for a day not worked, other than the absences the law pays. Each day taken takes one day's pay off the month: the monthly wage × 12 ÷ (52 × contract days a week) (PP 36/2021 art.40(1)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(a), 41(1): 100% of the wage for the first four months of illness, 75% for the next four, 50% for the next four and 25% thereafter until dismissal. One row: a sick day pays in full; a confirmed LONG_ILLNESS case starts the count, and closing it ends the count.

MEDICAL_LEAVE.description: Sick leave. A sick day is paid in full; in a long illness the wage is 100% for the first four months, 75% for the next four, 50% for the next four and 25% after that (PP 36/2021 art.41(1)).

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.82(1); UU 4/2024 (KIA) art.4(3)(a): three months of maternity leave, and up to three more where a doctor certifies a special condition of mother or child; art.5(2): paid in full for the first four months and 75% for the fifth and sixth. One row: a confirmed CHILD_BIRTH case opens 90 days, a confirmed BIRTH_COMPLICATION case 90 more, and each day is priced by its place from the birth case. Days beyond them go on UNPAID_LEAVE. PP 36/2021 art.40(5)(d).

MATERNITY_LEAVE.description: Maternity leave of three months, and up to three more where a doctor certifies a special condition of mother or child. It is paid in full for the first four months and at 75% for the fifth and sixth (UU 13/2003 art.82(1); UU 4/2024 arts.4–5).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c)(5), 41(3)(e): two paid days when the wife gives birth or miscarries; UU 4/2024 art.6(1): two days for a birth, which may be extended by up to three more days or as agreed (PATERNITY_EXTENSION_LEAVE), two days for a miscarriage. Window EVENT.
UU 4/2024 art.6(2); PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(e) — 2 days when the wife gives birth or miscarries

PATERNITY_LEAVE.description: Two paid days for a married male worker when his wife gives birth or miscarries (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(e); UU 4/2024 art.6(1)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(a): the paid days per event (3; window EVENT, `entry.event_kind`, `entry.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.
PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(a) — 3 paid days when the worker marries

MARRIAGE_LEAVE.description: Paid leave of 3 days for the worker's own marriage (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(a)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(b): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.event_kind`, `entry.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.
PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(b) — 2 paid days when the worker’s child marries

CHILD_MARRIAGE_LEAVE.description: Paid leave of 2 days for the marriage of the worker's child (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(b)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(c): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.event_kind`, `entry.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.
PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(c) — 2 paid days for a child’s circumcision

CHILD_CIRCUMCISION_LEAVE.description: Paid leave of 2 days for the circumcision of the worker's child (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(c)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(d): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.event_kind`, `entry.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.
PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(d) — 2 paid days for a child’s baptism

CHILD_BAPTISM_LEAVE.description: Paid leave of 2 days for the baptism of the worker's child (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(d)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(f): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.event_kind`, `entry.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.
PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(f) — 2 paid days on the death of a spouse, parent, parent-in-law, child or child-in-law

BEREAVEMENT_LEAVE.description: Paid leave of 2 days on the death of a spouse, parent, parent-in-law, child or child-in-law (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(f)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(g): the paid days per event (1; window EVENT, `entry.event_kind`, `entry.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.
PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(g) — 1 paid day on the death of another member of the household

BEREAVEMENT_HOUSEHOLD_LEAVE.description: Paid leave of 1 day on the death of a member of the worker's household (PP 36/2021 art.41(3)(g)).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(b), 41(2): a female worker sick on the first and second days of menstruation is paid for the days taken, at most 2; UU 13/2003 art.81(1).

MENSTRUAL_LEAVE.description: Paid leave for a female worker who is unwell on the first and second days of menstruation, at most two days (UU 13/2003 art.81(1); PP 36/2021 art.41(2)).

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.82(2): 1.5 months of rest, or as the doctor or midwife certifies, after a miscarriage — read as one month and fifteen days from the first day (`entry.from`..`entry.to`); paid in full (PP 36/2021 art.40(5)(e), art.46, https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021); UU 4/2024 art.4(2)(b).

MISCARRIAGE_LEAVE.description: Rest of one and a half months after a miscarriage, or as the doctor or midwife certifies, paid in full (UU 13/2003 art.82(2)).

references.title: UU 13/2003
references.quote: Pekerja/buruh tidak wajib bekerja pada hari-hari libur resmi.

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.85(2)–(3); PP 35/2021 art.31(2)–(3) — work on an official holiday is by agreement and is paid as overtime; the statute owes no day in lieu, so a day off in its place is the employer's by agreement, each granted through a leave adjustment
references.quote: Pengusaha yang mempekerjakan pekerja/buruh yang melakukan pekerjaan pada hari libur resmi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam ayat (2) wajib membayar upah kerja lembur.

PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_IN_LIEU.description: A paid day off in lieu of a public holiday worked, where the employer agrees one; HR grants each through a leave adjustment.

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(b), 43: the wage is paid while the worker performs a religious duty their religion commands, only once during the employment with the company: a second event (another `event_id`, or none) is refused.

RELIGIOUS_DUTY_LEAVE.description: Paid leave to perform a duty the worker's religion commands, such as the pilgrimage, once during the employment with the company (PP 36/2021 art.43).

WORK_ACCIDENT_LEAVE.description: Absence after a work accident or occupational disease while the worker cannot work. The wage is paid in full for the first 12 months from the accident (a WORK_ACCIDENT event on the contract) and at 50% after that until recovery; the employer claims it back from BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (PP 44/2015 as amended by PP 82/2019).

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.86; PP 44/2015 art.25 and Lampiran III as amended by PP 82/2019: while a worker is temporarily unable to work after a work accident or occupational disease the employer pays the wage (STMB) — 100% for the first 12 months, then 50% until recovery (secondary for the 50% tail; the official Lampiran could not be read) — and claims it back from BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.

PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(a), 42: a worker performing a duty to the state for at most one year is paid the shortfall between the state’s pay and the usual wage (the HR controller enters the state’s pay on the Deduction item); the worker notifies in writing (art.42(3)).

STATE_DUTY_LEAVE.description: Leave to perform a duty to the state, for at most one year. The employer pays the shortfall between what the state pays and the usual wage (PP 36/2021 art.42).

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(c), 44: paid at the usual wage, with the employer’s consent shown by written notice (`entry.employer_consent`).

UNION_DUTY_LEAVE.description: Time away on trade union duties with the employer's written consent, paid at the usual wage (PP 36/2021 art.44).

The PPh 21 on the whole gross of 2026 of a certain employee of an employer whose main KLU in the DJP database is in Lampiran A (133 codes: footwear, textile and garment, furniture, leather, tourism) is borne by the government for the tax periods January to December 2026 (arts.2–3). The employee holds an NPWP or a DJP-integrated NIK and, if permanent, received fixed and regular gross of at most Rp10,000,000 in January 2026 or in the first month worked in 2026 (art.4(2)); a non-permanent one at most Rp500,000 a day on average or Rp10,000,000 a month when paid monthly (art.4(3) / 4(5)). The tax is still computed and reported on the bukti potong (art.5(3)) and paid to the employee in cash with the wage (art.5(1), "pada saat pembayaran penghasilan"); a December excess is not refunded (art.5(5), Lampiran B example 3); the cash is not taxable income (art.5(2)). Final-taxed income is excluded (severance, art.4(6)).
